verdict.rationale: A live probe found llms.txt at https://docs.codegen.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), with a structured index linking to Markdown versions of doc pages. Many cited doc pages are served as raw .md files (CLI, settings, API reference), which gives agents clean, machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or documentation describing the agent-docs offering, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
